async_flow_in_milp.description: Set a technology's ability to have inflow in the same timestep that it has outflow, for any technology using the asynchronous flow binary switch.

force_async_flow.description: If True, non-zero `flow_out` and `flow_in` cannot both occur in the same timestep.
force_async_flow.title: Force asynchronous out/inflow.

async_flow_switch.description: Binary switch to force asynchronous outflow/consumption of technologies with both `flow_in` and `flow_out` defined. This ensures that a technology with carrier flow efficiencies < 100% cannot produce and consume a flow simultaneously to remove unwanted carrier from the system.
async_flow_switch.title: Asynchronous carrier flow switch

flow_in.description: The inflow to a technology per timestep, also known as the flow consumed (by `storage` technologies) or the flow sent (by `transmission` technologies) on a link.
flow_in.title: Carrier inflow
flow_in.where: carrier_in AND not (one_way AND map_dim(nodes, link_to)==True)
